question:
A 45-year-old man recovering from an anterior wall myocardial infarction, treated with emergent
coronary stenting and revascularization, is progressing well without complications. He has stated that
his wife, adult children, and cousins may receive information about his care and health status. On the
third day of hospitalization, a woman whom you recognize as the patient’s cousin approaches you in
the hallway outside his room. She inquires about the patient’s prognosis and recovery following his
heart attack. What is the most appropriate next step? Answer Choices: (A) Confirm with the patient
directly before sharing any information with the woman (B) Discuss the patient's hospital course and
expected prognosis with the woman (C) Decline to comment unless the patient is present to confirm his
consent (D) Inform the woman that disclosure to family members requires a signed HIPAA release form
(E) Provide only general information about myocardial infarctions without discussing specifics of the
patient's case (F) Ask for identification confirming that the woman is truly the patient's cousin (G)
Decline to comment per HIPAA patient confidentiality regulations (H) Request written authorization
from the patient before discussing his condition (I) Redirect the woman to the hospital’s medical
records department for further inquiries (J) Explain that only the patient's immediate family can receive
updates about his condition
 A. Provide only general information about myocardial infarctions without discussing specifics of the
patient's case
B. Decline to comment per HIPAA patient confidentiality regulations
C. Explain that only the patient's immediate family can receive updates about his condition
D. Discuss the patient's hospital course and expected prognosis with the woman
E. Inform the woman that disclosure to family members requires a signed HIPAA release form
F. Request written authorization from the patient before discussing his condition
G. Decline to comment unless the patient is present to confirm his consent
H. Confirm with the patient directly before sharing any information with the woman
I. Redirect the woman to the hospital’s medical records department for further inquiries
J. Ask for identification confirming that the woman is truly the patient's cousin
